The '''Fei Hu campaign''' was fought during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Lightspeed Panthers]], equipped with [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]], destroyed 286 [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] during the first nine [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the battle, losing only four craft in response.<ref name="TEGTW" />

The overall success of the T-65 during combat engagements forced the Empire to respond with the [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
